task_completion.description: Log in to the LimeSurvey admin panel successfully.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the LimeSurvey administration dashboard or the 'Vaccine Acceptance and Hesitancy Study' survey overview page after logging in with admin credentials.

task_completion.description: Add Spanish (es) as an additional language to the survey settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the survey 'General settings' or 'Text elements' tab, 'Spanish' or 'Español' should appear in the 'Additional languages' field.

task_completion.description: Provide Spanish translations for the survey title and description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Text elements' section for the Spanish version should show a translated title (e.g., containing 'vacunación' or 'aceptación') and a translated description.

task_completion.description: Translate all 8 questions across the two specified groups into Spanish.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The question editor or list view should show Spanish text for questions in both 'Vaccination Experience' and 'Attitudes and Beliefs' groups. At least 6-8 questions must be translated.

task_completion.description: Translate all multiple-choice answer options for the questions into Spanish.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Answer options' sub-menu for relevant questions should show Spanish text (e.g., 'Sí'/'No', 'De acuerdo'/'En desacuerdo') for the Spanish language tab.

task_completion.description: Ensure the Spanish version is accessible to respondents via the language switcher.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The public survey preview page should show a language dropdown menu containing 'Español', and selecting it should display the translated content.

integrity.description: The agent used the LimeSurvey web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with LimeSurvey buttons, text fields, and save icons.

integrity.description: The agent manually navigated to the translation tabs for each element.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the agent clicking on the 'Spanish' tabs within the LimeSurvey interface to input text.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the specific survey 'Vaccine Acceptance and Hesitancy Study'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The survey ID or title 'Vaccine Acceptance and Hesitancy Study' should be visible in the breadcrumbs or header during the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title is 'Vaccine Acceptance and Hesitancy Study'. The target language code is 'es'. There are exactly 8 questions (Q1-Q8) across two groups: 'Vaccination Experience' and 'Attitudes and Beliefs'. A successful translation must include Spanish keywords like 'vacunación', 'encuesta', or 'aceptación'. Full credit requires at least 6 of the 8 questions to be translated in the Spanish language tab.
